name: TallyQA: Answering Complex Counting Questions
description: TallyQA is a large-scale visual question answering benchmark focused on object counting and spatial relational reasoning. Spanning 287,907 questions across 165,000 images sourced from MS-COCO and Visual Genome, it distinguishes between simple counting (direct detection) and complex counting requiring relationship and attribute understanding.
